Chief Robinson suspects that Sharkey is a real ladies' man when he accidentally sees a Dear Jane letter in the typewriter.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E24 — Captive Crew
A group of convicts take over the work train and hold the entire construction crew hostage; Bill, who the convicts believe is dead, makes it back to the site and tries to stop them.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E25 — Showdown
Bill is planning to leave the railroad worker camp and move on, but a former crewman shows up to make trouble; Bill learns the man is working as field agent for the company that the workers hoped to get a new contract from.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E27 — The Governor's Lady
Bill saves a government agent from an ambush; the agent is carrying a list of landowners who are refusing to pay their taxes, and Bill learns the daughter of one of those landowners arranged the ambush.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E28 — Town Divided
Bill finds a town engulfed in a feud between two ranchers; he also learns that his former commanding officer is now a doctor who's turned to drinking, and a young man blames him for crippling his arm.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E29 — The Guilty And The Innocent
A lynch mob wants to hang a young man convicted of killing a family of homesteaders; Bill rides in with a stay of execution from the governor just as the mob is about to break into the jail; the desperate prisoner escapes.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E30 — Presentation Gun
Bill stops to visit his friend, a well-respected sheriff, only to find that the whole town has turned against him, and he's been jailed for killing an unarmed kid; Bill seeks to discover the real truth.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E32 — The Nomad
Bill comes to the defense of an unassuming man who is being bullied and tries to encourage him to stand up for himself; soon after, the man asks Bill to teach him how to use a gun.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E33 — Killer's Road
Bill takes the job of escorting a convicted killer to his hanging, knowing that the man's sons and gang members are planning to free him.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E34 — Lady Tenderfoot
An Easterner and his daughter hire Bill to guide them searching for a wild stallion to breed; however, an old enemy plans to follow them and rob the horse breeder to get revenge on Bill.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E35 — The Invisible Noose
Bill goes after the three men who had forced him to accompany them on a bank robbery then framed him for it after.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E37 — Johnny Tuvo
Bill befriends an overeager young man, Johnny Tuvo, who plans to challenge him in the upcoming horse race; however, two men at the event have more sinister plans.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E38 — The Accuser
Bill is captured by a posse and accused of being one of the men who robbed a bank and shot the banker; only the sheriff, whom the banker hates for being in love with his daughter, is inclined to believe Bill.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E39 — Mission To Monterey
Bill is sent into Mexico to investigate and put an end to a counterfeiting ring that's been operating there making phony American currency; the lawman he was to contact is ambushed and killed, leaving Bill to handle the situation alone.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E40 — Badman
Bill escorts a prisoner to Pueblo for trial; he is also to deliver money to the prisoner's mother for his daughter, whom she has custody of; the two men encounter a dust storm, which forces them to take refuge in a ghost town.

title: The Texan
description:
S02 E41 — 24 Hours To Live
Bill hopes to prove that his friend Steve Murrow is innocent of killing the man who married the girl he was hoping to marry, but he only has 24 hours to do it before Steve is hung; the town sheriff has threatened to kill Bill if he frees Steve.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E01 — Law of the Gun
Bill Longley arrives in a small Texas town with the intention of helping Les Torbit, an old army buddy, in his range war with Kyle Richards' outfit.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E02 — The Man With the Solid Gold Star
Professional gambler Jake Romer wins big in a poker game, taking thousands of dollars in IOUs from Jim Caldwell, an ex-lawman.

title: The Texan
description:
S01 E03 — The Troubled Town
Hot-headed Johnny Kaler, embarrassed that he's been caught cheating at cards, provokes Bill Longley into a barroom brawl and is quickly thrashed.

title: The Texan
description:

Bill Longley meets an old, but beautiful, friend who currently owns the local saloon and is happy to renew her acquaintance.

title: The Texan
description:

description:

Two gunmen rob Bill Longley, taking his $8,300 he earned for taking a herd of cattle to Mesa.

title: The Texan
description:

After Longley is forced to kill a barfly that tried to shoot him in the back, he learns a quirk in the Montana law code.

title: The Texan
description:

While escorting to prison the leader of a notorious gang, a sheriff and a deputy are attacked by the gang.

description:

title: The Texan

Bill has been hired to guide two Easterners who want to capture wild stallions to use as studs for breeding.

title: The Texan
description:

title: The Texan
description:

title: The Texan
description:

title: The Texan
description:

title: The Texan
description:

Longley rescues the lone survivor of a murderous stagecoach robbery, but the man refuses to help him identify the three killers.

title: The Texan
description:

Reno comes to the aid of a town bully, only to have the man return the favor by alerting authorities to Reno's whereabouts.
